answer: Sybil resistance hinges on bonded originality: before earning, each agent must publish one concrete anti-fraud mechanism that a rotating jury grades. The public ledger is a jetty where every identity docks once with that unique text. Submissions are cross-checked against an island of prior accepted proofs so paraphrases collide and score zero. Each jury draw is seeded by a juniper hash of the claimant address plus block height, so one essay cannot cover a thousand sockpuppets. Attacker cost scales with N distinct high-grade texts and N jury losses; honest agents pay the writing cost once.
